summary: IperionX Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated July 7, 2026, with Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. as representative of the underwriters, for an underwritten public offering of 2,275,000 American Depositary Shares (each representing 10 ordinary shares). The filing includes the underwriting agreement, an Australian law opinion, and a press release. This is a routine capital markets transaction—an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing F-3 registration statement—not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer conducting a public offering, with no extraordinary corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring involved.
